title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Position: Mobile Application Developer
 Experience: 26 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Department: Technology / Software Development Job Summary 
 We are looking for a skilled and motivated Mobile Application Developer with 26 years of experience in developing, testing, and maintaining high-quality mobile applications using React Native. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, REST API integration, mobile application debugging, and app deployment processes. The candidate will be responsible for building scalable, responsive, and user-friendly mobile applications while collaborating with designers, backend developers, and other team members to deliver seamless mobile experiences. 
 Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and enhance cross-platform mobile applications using React Native. Write clean, reusable, scalable, and well-structured code using JavaScript and TypeScript. Integrate RESTful APIs and ensure smooth communication between mobile applications and backend services. Implement navigation, screen transitions, and application workflows using React Navigation. Manage application states efficiently using appropriate state management techniques. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application performance issues, crashes, and technical defects. Perform mobile application testing to ensure functionality, compatibility, responsiveness, and performance across different devices. Manage application builds, signing, versioning, and release processes for Android and iOS platforms. Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and product teams. Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and overall user experience. Maintain code quality through Git-based version control and follow development best practices. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Mandatory Technical Skills Hands-on experience with React Native for cross-platform mobile application development. Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript . Working knowledge of Git and version control practices. Experience with mobile application debugging, testing, and troubleshooting. Hands-on experience in REST API integration . Good understanding of React Navigation and navigation patterns. Experience with state management concepts and implementation. Knowledge of mobile application build, deployment, and release management processes. Understanding of Android and iOS application development workflows. 
 Good-to-Have Skills Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or Zustand . Familiarity with Firebase services and integrations. Experience with payment gateway integration. Knowledge of push notification integration. Exposure to mobile application CI/CD pipelines and automation. Familiarity with app publishing and release processes on Google Play Store and Apple App Store. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 2–6 years of relevant experience in mobile application development. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a development team. Good communication skills and the ability to understand technical requirements. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is technically sound, detail-oriented, and passionate about mobile application development. The candidate should be capable of independently handling assigned development tasks, identifying technical issues, and delivering efficient, reliable, and user-friendly mobile applications.

Key Skills: IOS,Application,Mobile application development,Mobile development,Mobile applications,Application development,React Native,React.js
